method: OpenAI built-in imagegen via Codex CLI (codex exec, image_generation tool), then scripts/prepare-footer-landscape.py
purpose: Tall, seamless, horizontally repeating landscape tile across the full width of the shared site footer (SiteFooterBase); calm water fills the bottom of the tile and runs off the bottom edge, giving scroll room while the footer sun rises behind the hills. Website decoration only; not an app screenshot, app feature or Press Kit material.
styleReferences: the first footer landscape from the same imagegen series (water running off the bottom edge)
an earlier tall footer tile from the same series (hammock cat, sheep, cottages; cozy-doodle style after src/assets/img/doze-landscape-day-cozy-doodle.png)
prompt:
Use case: a tall, horizontally SEAMLESS, repeatable landscape tile for the full-width footer of the "lazyapps" website (CSS background repeat-x). The calm water must reach all the way down to the bottom edge of the image, like the first attached image and like a lakeside illustration whose lake fills the bottom of the frame. There is NO bank, grass, bushes or plants below the water: the bottom of the image is only water.

Attached image 1 shows the wanted water treatment and the wanted overall feel: pale paper-white water with a few thin horizontal ink ripple lines, running off the bottom edge. Attached image 2 shows the wanted scene content and style: rolling sage hills, a hammock with a sleeping cat between two trees, three dozing cream sheep, terracotta-roofed cottages with a chimney puff, egg-shaped and cypress trees, rounded bushes.

Composition: aspect 2:1 (wide).
- Top ~30%: empty pure white sky (no sun, moon, clouds, birds).
- About 30-58%: the distant rolling hills, then the mid-ground scene from image 2 on a grassy shore: the hammock with the sleeping cat on the left, the three sheep in the middle, the cottages on the right, with a few trees and bushes. The land band must run continuously across the whole width.
- About 56-62%: an irregular, gently curving shoreline with small reed tufts, a few stones and a tiny wooden jetty below the cottages.
- About 60-100%: calm open water filling the whole bottom part and running off the bottom edge and both side edges: pale paper-white with sparse thin horizontal ripple lines, very soft faint reflections of the shore trees just under the shoreline, a couple of small lily pads, and one tiny empty wooden rowboat drifting in the water. Keep most of the water quiet and empty.
The left edge and right edge must continue into each other perfectly at every height (hills, shore, water lines), and no object may be cut by the left or right edge.

Background: pure flat white (#FFFFFF) in the sky, no paper texture, no vignette, no border.

Style: exactly the attached images: hand-drawn dark olive-brown ink outlines of even medium weight, flat muted sage / olive / moss fills, cream sheep, terracotta roofs. No gradients, no photorealism.

Mood: calm, sleepy late afternoon, evenly distributed, no single dominant focal point.

Must avoid: text, letters, logos, watermarks, sun, moon, people, frames, borders, shadows, mockups, UI, any land, bank, grass or plants along the bottom edge, any object cut by the left or right edge.
processing: Wrap seam repaired by an imagegen edit (see seamRepair), then closed over 16 px, paper-white snapped to #FFFFFF, multiply-baked onto the footer panel color #FCF9ED, open sky connected to the top edge made transparent so the footer sun can sit behind the hills.

seamRepair.method: Same imagegen, image edit of the tile rolled by half its width so the wrap seam sat in the center; only a 220 px feathered band around that seam was taken from the edit, then the tile was rolled back.
seamRepair.prompt:
The attached landscape has a visible vertical join exactly down the horizontal center of the image (x = 50%), where the left half and the right half do not line up: the distant hill outlines step or break there. Repair ONLY that center strip (about 6% of the width around the vertical center line): redraw the distant hill silhouettes, the grass, the shoreline, the reflections and the water lines so they continue smoothly and naturally across the center, in exactly the same hand-drawn style, line weight and colors.

Keep everything else pixel-identical: same size and aspect (2:1), same positions of every hill, tree, cat, sheep, cottage, jetty, boat, lily pad and water line, same pure white sky, no new objects, no sun, no text.
